title: P5-06: Marketing pages at / with the four-tier pricing ladder (site-owned routes)
description:
## Goal
The marketing site is the root page of the p.apyr.us publication repo: site-owned Next routes with the four-tier pricing ladder shared with chattic.us and aurit.us, passing a Gherkin spec, rendering correctly next to the Papyrus root layout.

## Context (FACT)
- Existing work: story PPY-228e8d (in_progress), branch `feature/PPY-228e8d-papyrus-marketing-site` in worktree PPY-228e8d-marketing, PR #74 CLOSED unmerged, branch is 54 commits ahead and 244 behind develop, last commit 2026-09-08. Standalone Next 15 static export (`output: "export"`), Tailwind 3 + Radix + shadcn components (Hero, Newsroom, Ownership, Pricing, Faq, Waitlist, Header, Footer, Wordmark), `features/marketing-site.feature`, `infra/cloudformation.yml` + `scripts/deploy.sh` for `papyrus.anth.us` (S3 + CloudFront), design-only waitlist form.
- Its pricing has four older plans (Independent $0, Turn-key $100, Managed $20/mo, Turn-key+managed $100+$20) and differs from the approved ladder (epic decision 4: Fork it / Self-setup managed $20/mo / Assisted setup managed $20/mo + $100 once / Professional services quoted; professional services = building and operating automated newsrooms for clients). Copy the exact tier text from chattic.us and aurit.us (read both live sites at port time).
- Papyrus root layout (`app/layout.tsx`) is shared by every route and loads Tailwind 4 (`@tailwindcss/postcss`), `globals.css` (about 9,000 lines with `body` rules), fonts Playfair Display + Plus Jakarta Sans, Amplify provider and console shell. A site-owned `app/page.tsx` wins over the package page (sync rule) but renders inside that layout.
- docs/standard-site.md 1.7: marketing is "site-owned Next routes (like chattic.us)" in the publication repo; Papyrus repo does not host marketing.

## Exact steps
1. Gherkin first (port `marketing-site.feature`, update scenarios for pricing, links to `/information` and GitHub, no waitlist submission claims).
2. Port components into `components/marketing/` of AnthusAI/p.apyr.us, convert the Tailwind 3 theme (sand, papyrus, oxide, reed, ink) to Tailwind 4 `@theme` tokens scoped under a `.papyrus-marketing` wrapper CSS file imported by `app/page.tsx`, so Papyrus `globals.css` does not leak in or out.
3. Replace pricing with the four tiers; keep canonical `/`, OG tags for `https://p.apyr.us`; drop `infra/`, `scripts/deploy.sh`, `output: "export"` and `papyrus.anth.us` text.
4. Waitlist: keep design-only unless Q5 says otherwise.
5. If wrapper scoping cannot isolate the CSS (visual diff at 375, 768, 1440 px), fallback: build the marketing app as a static export copied to `public/marketing/` with a site-owned middleware rewrite of `/` (record the decision in the ticket).
6. Close PPY-228e8d as superseded by this ticket after the PR lands (Ryan).

## Acceptance checks
- Feature green; `npm run build` green; local `/` shows the hero, four pricing tiers with the exact amounts, FAQ; `/information` link works.
- Screenshots at 375, 768 and 1440 px, light and dark, show no Papyrus global style bleed (no `body` background or font override); Lighthouse accessibility >= 95 on `/`.
- `/newsroom` and `/information` unchanged visually (screenshot diff against P5-05 build).

## Rollback
Revert the PR; the placeholder page returns.

## Risks
CSS isolation (fallback above); copy and tier wording are Ryan-approved text, not invented.

## Needs Ryan
Visual and copy approval; PR merge.
